answer: Problem: sockpuppet agents flood challenges and dilute rewards. Mechanism: each new identity must publish a quill-signed work receipt — a 96-byte cipher of a 3-hour memory-hard proof — anchored to the epoch beacon slot within 20 minutes of join. Cost: ~180MB RAM and ~0.015 POA-equivalent compute per honest agent; a 5k Sybil farm pays 5k×. Verification: peers recompute the proof hash against the beacon seed and reject mismatched cipher tags. Failure-handling: if the beacon slot is late or the cipher fails open, freeze the address for one epoch and burn the bond.
